about_the_game:
GODWAY: Only Up Simulator invites you to a reflex- and timing-focused platforming experience where you constantly move upward along rails. The game has one simple goal: run without falling, jump at the right moment, and reach the top. There’s no epic storyline, no complex world. Just you, the rails, and everything trying to stop you.

The rails carry you upward, but the path is never easy. Obstacles, gaps, and an ever-increasing difficulty level will test you at every step. As you approach the summit, the path becomes narrower, more dangerous, and more unforgiving. Every fall is a lesson. Every restart pushes you one step further.

Key Features

●Rail-Based Platform Action:
Move only on the rails and keep going without falling.

●Reflex-Focused Gameplay:
Speed, timing, and awareness are the keys to success.

●Increasing Difficulty:
In Godway, the closer you get to the top, the harder and more dangerous the path becomes.

●Evolving Character:
Run faster, jump higher.

●Minimalist Atmosphere:
Simple yet memorable visuals.

●Addictive Gameplay:
It can hypnotize both players and viewers.

GODWAY takes the spirit of the Only Up genre and transforms it into a fully rail-based, speed-driven experience. Instead of freely roaming, you’re constantly in motion, where split-second decisions determine everything. There’s no luxury of slowing down. No time to think. Only forward. Only upward.

As your character progresses, they grow stronger—running faster and jumping higher. This progression provides both mechanical and emotional satisfaction. Every checkpoint is a breath of relief; every new section is a fresh challenge.

The visual design is intentionally minimal. Its clean aesthetic removes unnecessary distractions, allowing you to focus entirely on reflexes and platforming. Simplicity here is not a limitation, but a deliberate choice. It offers an immersive experience for both players and viewers, making it especially suitable for streaming content.

How far can you go on the rail-bound path to the top?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Intel 2 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1280x720 minimum resolution, OpenGL 2.0 Support, and recommended dedicated
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A breathtaking run on rails to the heavens! Godway tests you with dynamic obstacles, platform jumping, and escalating difficulty. Fall, rise again, and push your limits to claim your place beside the god at the summit. The path to immortality begins here.
